stemMarkdown: In which month did the largest number of passengers arrive on time?
solutionMarkdown:
Multiply each bar by its own point on the line:

- Jan: $ 12 \times 82\% = 9.84$ lakh
- Feb: $ 15 \times 78\% = 11.7$ lakh
- Mar: $ 18 \times 70\% = 12.6$ lakh
- Apr: $ 14 \times 85\% = 11.9$ lakh
- May: $ 20 \times 74\% = 14.8$ lakh

**May**, at 14.8 lakh. April has the best on-time percentage and ranks third on this measure, because the percentage is applied to a smaller base.
